For those who haven't seen it, Neemias Queta spoke with Miguel Candeias of @abola.bsky.social about his four-year, $56M extension with the Celtics.

"The most important thing was to know that Boston bet on me for another four years. I'll be able to continue to call Boston home all this time."

items.title: It sounds like the Celtics will enter next season with Neemias Queta remaining as the team's starting center.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
It sounds like the Celtics will enter next season with Neemias Queta remaining as the team's starting center.

While dealing with hack-a-Mitch creates a compelling case to start Robinson, I wrote about why entering the year with Queta in the first unit is the right approach.

items.author: Noa Dalzell
items.body_excerpt:
NEW STORY: It's Neemias Queta's 5th time at Summer League. 

The first 4 times, he was a player fighting to keep his NBA dreams alive.

This time, he showed up on the heels of a big-time extension. 

“I've been wishing for something like that to happen."
